prompts.question: Is the company listed in the SEC Investment Adviser Public Disclosure (IAPD) database as a registered investment adviser, and does its Form ADV show owners or disciplinary disclosures?
prompts.why_it_matters: IAPD is the official US record of an adviser's registration, owners and disclosed regulatory history.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the IAPD firm search and enter the company's legal name, then open any matching Form ADV record.
prompts.found_when: A firm record with the same legal name appears and its Form ADV or disclosure pages are readable.
prompts.not_found_when: The firm search returns no match for the company's legal name in any state.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The name matches many unrelated firms, or the IAPD search and record pages will not load.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the FDIC BankFind Suite as an FDIC-insured depository institution, and does its record show enforcement orders?
prompts.why_it_matters: FDIC records confirm whether a bank's deposit insurance and charter claims are genuine.
prompts.how_to_query: Search FDIC BankFind Suite by institution name and review the charter, insurance and enforcement details.
prompts.found_when: An institution record with the same name appears with FDIC insurance and charter information.
prompts.not_found_when: The institution search returns no bank under the company's name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search tool is unavailable, or several banks share the name with different certificates.

prompts.question: Does Bloomberg carry news coverage or a company credit profile for this company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Bloomberg coverage shows the company is tracked by financial markets, and its reporting can corroborate or contradict the company's own claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Bloomberg site search with the company name and review the resulting news articles and company pages.
prompts.found_when: Bloomberg search returns company pages or articles naming the company as the subject.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no Bloomberg article or company profile for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Bloomberg is blocked by a paywall or bot check, or the name returns only unrelated matches.

prompts.question: Is the company registered with FINRA and listed on BrokerCheck as a broker-dealer or investment adviser, and does its record show sanctions or customer disputes?
prompts.why_it_matters: BrokerCheck is the official US record of a financial firm's licensing, arbitrations and disciplinary history.
prompts.how_to_query: Open BrokerCheck and enter the firm name in the firm search box.
prompts.found_when: A firm record with the matching name appears with its registrations, disputes or disciplinary disclosures.
prompts.not_found_when: The firm search returns no broker-dealer or adviser under the company's name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: BrokerCheck search or its detail pages are unavailable, or the name matches many similarly named firms.

prompts.question: Does the company have a Built In profile for one of its US locations, and does that profile match its stated size and technology?
prompts.why_it_matters: A missing or inconsistent Built In profile weakens the company's recruiting visibility and flags claims that do not line up.
prompts.how_to_query: Search builtin.com for the company name and open the matching company profile.
prompts.found_when: A company profile appears with locations, headcount or technology details.
prompts.not_found_when: The company search returns no profile for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search endpoint or profile page is unavailable, or the name is too generic to match uniquely.

prompts.question: Does CB Insights carry a company profile for this company, and what does it show about its funding, investors and competitors?
prompts.why_it_matters: A CB Insights profile gives an independent view of the company's funding and market position that can be compared with its own story.
prompts.how_to_query: Search cbinsights.com for the company name and open the matching company profile page.
prompts.found_when: A CB Insights company page exists for the company with funding, investor or market details.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no company profile for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile is gated or not shown, or the name matches several different companies.

prompts.question: Do IT professionals discuss this company as a vendor in the Spiceworks Community, and what do the vendor pages and threads say about its support and service levels?
prompts.why_it_matters: Practitioner feedback reveals delivery and support problems that official marketing material hides.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Spiceworks Community for the company name and open the vendor pages and discussion threads that mention it.
prompts.found_when: Vendor pages, reviews or threads naming the company are found and readable.
prompts.not_found_when: The community search returns no post or vendor page naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The community search is unavailable, or generic company names return only incidental mentions.

prompts.question: Are there consumer complaints filed against this company in the CFPB Consumer Complaint Database, and how does the company respond to them?
prompts.why_it_matters: Complaint volumes and company responses are a public record of how the company treats its customers.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the CFPB Consumer Complaint Database, enter the company name and review complaint volumes, categories and company responses.
prompts.found_when: Complaints are returned under the company's name with response details.
prompts.not_found_when: The complaint search returns no records for the company's name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The complaint API or search page is unavailable, or the name matches several institutions with similar names.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the NAIC Consumer Insurance Search as a licensed insurer, and does its profile show complaint ratios or closed complaints?
prompts.why_it_matters: NAIC records verify an insurer's licensing and give a public complaint picture by line of insurance.

source.name: NAIC Consumer Insurance Search (National Association of Insurance Commissioners)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the NAIC consumer insurance company search and enter the company's insurance entity name.
prompts.found_when: A company result appears with licensing, financial summary or complaint ratio details.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no insurance company under the company's name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search dashboard does not load, or the name is shared by several related group entities.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in EPA ECHO with regulated facilities, permits, inspections or enforcement actions?
prompts.why_it_matters: Environmental enforcement and penalty history is a material compliance and reputational risk.

source.name: EPA ECHO (Enforcement and Compliance History Online)

prompts.how_to_query: Search EPA ECHO by facility or company name and review compliance status, inspections and penalties.
prompts.found_when: Facility records under the company's name appear with permits, inspections or enforcement data.
prompts.not_found_when: The ECHO search returns no regulated facility under the company's name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ECHO search is down or the name returns facilities with no clear ownership link.

prompts.question: Does the FDA's warning letter and inspection record list this company, for example with a warning letter, Form 483 observations or a recall?
prompts.why_it_matters: FDA enforcement actions indicate manufacturing or product compliance failures.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the FDA warning letters datatable, and the inspection and recall databases, for the company's name.
prompts.found_when: A warning letter, inspection observation or recall naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The FDA searches return no enforcement, inspection or recall record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The FDA search views fail to load, or the name is too generic to tie to one company.

prompts.question: Does Forbes profile this company or rank it on one of its lists, such as America's Largest Private Companies?
prompts.why_it_matters: A Forbes profile or ranking position is third-party recognition of the company's scale and standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Search forbes.com for the company name and check for a company profile page or ranking entry.
prompts.found_when: A Forbes company page or ranking entry naming the company is found.
prompts.not_found_when: The Forbes search returns no profile or ranking entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Search results or profile pages are gated or unreadable, or the name matches other companies.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Fortune's rankings, such as the Fortune 500 or Global 500, or in its Most Admired Companies list?
prompts.why_it_matters: Fortune list placement is a widely used public measure of the company's size and standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Fortune ranking search page and scan the relevant list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company is named in a Fortune ranking with a rank or revenue figure.
prompts.not_found_when: The ranking lists contain no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The ranking pages do not load or the list year being read is unclear.

prompts.question: Does the FTC Legal Library contain any case or proceeding involving this company?
prompts.why_it_matters: FTC actions reveal antitrust or consumer protection problems, such as deceptive advertising, on the public record.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the FTC legal library case browse page with the company name in quotes.
prompts.found_when: A case or proceeding record naming the company is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The FTC search returns no case or proceeding for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page is unavailable, or the company name is too common to link to one case.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search with an active 501(c)(3) or 501(c)(6) tax-exempt status?
prompts.why_it_matters: IRS records confirm whether a claimed non-profit status is real and still active.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search by organisation name and review the exemption status and filings.
prompts.found_when: An organisation record appears with an active exemption status and filing history.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no exempt organisation under the company's name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The IRS search tool is unavailable, or the name matches many similarly named charities.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on the National Retail Federation's Top 100 Retailers list?
prompts.why_it_matters: Placement on the NRF list independently confirms the company's size in US retail.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the NRF Top 100 Retailers list page and scan the ranked table for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The ranked table names the company with a rank or revenue figure.
prompts.not_found_when: The list contains no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The list page does not load or the edition being read is not stated.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member on the National Venture Capital Association (NVCA) members page?
prompts.why_it_matters: NVCA membership is a sign that the firm is an established, recognised participant in the US venture industry.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the NVCA members page and scan the directory of member firms for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The members page lists the company as an NVCA member.
prompts.not_found_when: The members page contains no listing for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The members page does not load or the membership list is not published in full.

prompts.question: Has this company published press releases through PR Newswire, and do those releases support its claims about products, leadership and results?
prompts.why_it_matters: Timed press releases give a dated record that can confirm or contradict what the company now says about itself.
prompts.how_to_query: Search prnewswire.com by organisation name and review the company's release history.
prompts.found_when: Releases attributed to the company are returned with dates and content.
prompts.not_found_when: The organisation search returns no releases for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search results are unavailable, or several companies share the same name.

prompts.question: Does the ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer hold IRS Form 990 filings for this company, and do the reported finances match what it says publicly?
prompts.why_it_matters: Digitised Form 990 data shows a non-profit's real revenue, salaries and grants, which often contradicts campaign claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer by the organisation's name or EIN and open its Form 990 filings.
prompts.found_when: A nonprofit record appears with one or more Form 990 filings and financial figures.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no organisation record for the company's name or EIN.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site is unreachable, or the name matches several unrelated non-profits.

prompts.question: Is the company registered in SAM.gov as a federal contractor, and does its record show active exclusions or debarments?
prompts.why_it_matters: SAM.gov confirms a contractor's legal identity, UEI and whether it is barred from federal work.
prompts.how_to_query: Search sam.gov by legal business name and review the entity registration, UEI and exclusion records.
prompts.found_when: An entity record appears with a UEI and registration status, and any exclusions are shown.
prompts.not_found_when: The entity search returns no registration for the company's legal name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: SAM.gov requires a login or captcha that blocks the search, or the name returns many similar entities.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on the OFAC Sanctions List Search as a Specially Designated National or otherwise sanctioned party?
prompts.why_it_matters: A sanctions hit would make dealings with the company unlawful for US-linked businesses.

source.name: OFAC Sanctions List Search (U.S. Department of the Treasury)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the OFAC Sanctions List Search, submit the company name with a low minimum score and review close matches.
prompts.found_when: A designation record matches the company's name and identifying details.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no designation matching the company name and identifiers.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search form or results page fails, or the name is too generic to separate real matches from noise.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in U.S. Small Business Administration records, for example with an 8(a) or HUBZone certification or an SBA-backed loan?
prompts.why_it_matters: SBA records verify claimed small-business certifications and reveal the company's access to federal loan programmes.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the SBA certification search by company name and review any certification or loan records it returns.
prompts.found_when: A certification or loan record naming the company is returned with its status.
prompts.not_found_when: The SBA search returns no certification or loan record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The certification API or search page is unavailable, or the name matches several registered entities.

prompts.question: Does the company file with the SEC in EDGAR, and do its filings support the financial and corporate claims it makes?
prompts.why_it_matters: EDGAR filings are audited, legally binding disclosures that can be compared directly with the company's own statements.

source.name: SEC EDGAR (U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the SEC EDGAR company search, enter the company name and review its filing history.
prompts.found_when: A filer entry exists and its filings such as 10-K or 8-K are readable.
prompts.not_found_when: EDGAR returns no filer under the company's name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: EDGAR rate-limits or blocks the request, or the name matches several unrelated filers.

prompts.question: Does SiteJabber carry a review page for this company, and do reviewers report billing or refund problems?
prompts.why_it_matters: Repeated consumer complaints about billing and refunds are an early warning of poor commercial conduct.
prompts.how_to_query: Search sitejabber.com for the company name and open its review page and rating.
prompts.found_when: A review page for the company exists with ratings and customer comments.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no review page for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The review page is blocked or empty of readable content, or the name matches other merchants.

prompts.question: Do employees discuss this company on Blind, and what do the anonymous posts say about layoffs, management or pay?
prompts.why_it_matters: Verified-employee chatter surfaces internal problems such as layoffs or mismanagement long before they become public.
prompts.how_to_query: Search teamblind.com for the company page and read its reviews and discussion posts.
prompts.found_when: A company page or posts about the company are found and readable.
prompts.not_found_when: No company page or discussion post about the company is found.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site blocks the request or requires a verified work login to show content.

prompts.question: Has TechCrunch reported on this company, for example its funding rounds, launches or setbacks, and do those reports match the company's own claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: Independent startup reporting dates and verifies funding and product claims the company makes.
prompts.how_to_query: Search techcrunch.com for the company name and review the resulting articles and tag pages.
prompts.found_when: TechCrunch articles naming the company as the subject are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no article about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search or tag pages are unavailable, or the name matches unrelated subjects.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on the Consolidated Screening List as subject to US export restrictions, such as the BIS Entity List or Denied Persons List?
prompts.why_it_matters: Export restriction listings mean US-linked trade with the company is restricted or prohibited.

source.name: Consolidated Screening List (U.S. International Trade Administration)

prompts.how_to_query: Download the Consolidated Screening List file and search it for the company's name across the included restriction lists.
prompts.found_when: An entry matching the company's name and details appears on one of the listed restriction lists.
prompts.not_found_when: The list contains no entry matching the company's name and identifiers.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The download fails or the name is too generic to separate real matches from noise.

prompts.question: Has this company received US federal contracts, grants or loans recorded on USAspending.gov, and how large are the awards?
prompts.why_it_matters: Federal award data shows the company's real public-sector revenue and can contradict its stated track record.
prompts.how_to_query: Search usaspending.gov by recipient name and review the awards and total obligations shown.
prompts.found_when: Award records naming the company as recipient are returned with amounts.
prompts.not_found_when: The recipient search returns no federal awards for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search or API is unavailable, or the name matches several similarly named recipients.

prompts.question: Does the company hold registered trademarks or patents at the USPTO, and are any marks it claims abandoned or cancelled?
prompts.why_it_matters: USPTO records show whether branding and technology ownership claims are actually registered and in force.

source.name: United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the USPTO trademark and patent databases by owner name and by the claimed mark, and review each filing status.
prompts.found_when: Trademark or patent records owned by or naming the company are returned with their status.
prompts.not_found_when: The USPTO searches return no trademark or patent record for the company or its claimed marks.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The USPTO search tool is unavailable, or the name matches many unrelated applicants.

prompts.question: Does the company have a Wellfound profile, and what does it disclose about its funding stage, team size and equity offers?
prompts.why_it_matters: A Wellfound profile gives a public, comparable statement of the company's stage and hiring terms.
prompts.how_to_query: Search wellfound.com for the company name and open the matching company profile.
prompts.found_when: A company profile exists with funding stage, headcount or compensation details.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile requires a login to view, or the name matches several startups.
